student engagement is the positive affective-motivational state of students in classrooms, and that student disengagement is the negative affective-motivation state of students in the classroom.
student engagement is a positive, fulfilling, work-related state of mind that is characterised by vigor, dedication, and absorption.
student engagement and dis engagement are the degree to which students are activated and/or pleased in the classroom.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
student engagement and disengage- ment should be conceptualised as the degree of activation and pleasure that students experience in the classroom context.
student engagement and dis-engagement can be conceptualised as a two-dimensional construct with activation and pleasure as two distinct dimensions.
student engagement is a state of mind characterised by a high level of activation and high level of pleasure in a classroom context.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the meaning and measurement of student engagement is more complex than is commonly assumed.
